title: ASTENZ – A Preliminary Feasibility Study to Evaluate an Interactive Online Application in Advanced Cancer
summary: This study is testing a new interactive online application (ASTENZ) designed to support people with advanced cancer and their relatives in addressing questions and issues related to the end of life. The study examines how well the app can be used in everyday clinical practice – with a focus on usability, usage, and acceptance. The use of the app will be compared with standard care. Participants will be randomly assigned to one of two groups: with or without app use. In addition to collecting questionnaire data, interviews with users about the app usage will also be conducted. The study is designed as an early feasibility study to inform a future, more comprehensive evaluation of the app’s effectiveness.

interventions.name: Use of the app for four/eight weeks

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Positive Surprise Question, sufficient knowledge of the German language, capacity to provide informed consent of patients/caregivers, consent to participate
Exclusion criteria:
under curative treatment
